name: frontdesk
description: Manage Bevado AI agent settings, CRM records, and automation workflows.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Bevado account to inspect AI receptionist settings, prompts, workflows, CRM records, sequences, and calendar connections. Choose the organizations, agents, and permissions to grant. Available tools depend on your account and approved access. Configuration changes use a preview and approval step before commit. A Bevado account and MCP pilot access are currently required.
defaultPrompt: Show my Bevado agents and summarize the selected agent's greeting and call prompt.
Explain the steps and branches of a Bevado follow-up sequence without running it.
Preview a greeting change for my Bevado receptionist and wait for my approval.
